title.narrative: Promoting Girls' Participation and Performance in STEM Through Mathematics Pedagogy in LAC

description.narrative: The project aims to identify and disseminate effective pedagogical practices and innovations in mathematics education that promote the participation and performance of girls in STEM. This will be achieved through the following key actions: 1. Expanding the Network: Scale up the existing network of trainers teachers in mathematics pedagogy established by the UNESCO Chair. This will include connecting it with the Network of Deans of Education from Latin American Universities and aligning efforts with the LAC Regional Teacher Strategy to be launched in 2025. 2. Capacity Development: Organize professional development workshops and training sessions to equip teachers with gender-sensitive pedagogical tools and approaches. These will emphasize fostering inclusive classrooms encouraging girls to engage with STEM subjects. 3. Knowledge Generation and Sharing: Conduct research to document and analyze successful pedagogical practices and innovations. The findings will be disseminated through publications, webinars, and regional events to facilitate broader adoption across the region. 4. Monitoring and Evaluation: Implement a M&E framework to assess the initiative's impact on girls' participation and performance in STEM, informing future interventions. 5. Bringing the Experience to Scale: Leverage the tools and approaches developed by Imagining Our Grantmaking Goals (IMAGO) in Sumar Saberes (public-private network) to assess the scalability of the identified practices. • Participatory Design and Co-Creation: Involve stakeholders, including teachers, policymakers, and community leaders, in the design and adaptation of initiatives to ensure relevance and inclusivity. • Systematic Scaling Framework: Apply IMAGO’s scaling framework to expand the initiative's reach across diverse contexts within the LAC region. • Technology-Enabled Solutions: Use digital platforms and tools to provide ongoing support, training, and resources to teachers, enabling widespread implementation. • Collaboration and Partnerships: Foster multi-sectoral partnerships to mobilize resources and expertise, ensuring sustainable and scalable outcomes (e.g., propose a collaboration with the Ministry of Science in Chile).
